import re, pandas as pd
MON={'jan':1,'feb':2,'mar':3,'apr':4,'may':5,'jun':6,'jul':7,'aug':8,'sep':9}
lines=open('personal_expenses.txt',encoding='utf8').read().splitlines()[3:]
dpat=re.compile(r'(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})|\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})(?:/(\d{2}))?\b|\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b|\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b')
rows=[];bad=[]
for ln in lines:
    if not ln.strip(): continue
    s=ln.strip()
    am=re.findall(r'(-?\$?-?\d+\.\d{2})\s*$',s) or re.findall(r'(-?\$?-?\d+\.\d{2})',s)
    # amount: the token with decimals not part of a date
    cand=re.findall(r'(?<![\d/-])(-?\$?-?\d{1,5}\.\d{2})(?!\d)',s)
    dm=dpat.search(s)
    if len(cand)!=1 or not dm: bad.append(s);continue
    a=cand[0]; amt=float(a.replace('$',''))
    g=dm.groups()
    if g[0]: m,d=int(g[1]),int(g[2])
    elif g[3]: m,d=int(g[3]),int(g[4])
    elif g[6]: m,d=int(g[6]),int(g[7])
    else: m,d=MON[g[8].lower()],int(g[9])
    desc=s.replace(dm.group(0),' ').replace(a,' ')
    desc=re.sub(r'\(\s*\)','',desc)
    desc=re.sub(r'^[\s\-|:,]+|[\s\-|:,]+$','',re.sub(r'\s*[-|:]{1,2}\s*(?=[-|:,]|$)','',re.sub(r'\s+',' ',desc)))
    desc=re.sub(r'\s*(--|\s-\s|\|)\s*$','',desc).strip(' -|:,()')
    desc=re.sub(r'^Return processed - ','Return: ',desc)
    rows.append(dict(date=pd.Timestamp(2026,m,d),desc=desc,amt=amt,raw=s))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(len(lines),len(df),'unparsed:',bad)
print(sorted(df.desc.unique()))
df.to_pickle('df.pkl')
EOF
python "$TEMP/p.py"
